name: ScriptBridge for TelemetryDeck
author: whakkee

sections.description:
ScriptBridge for TelemetryDeck lets you quickly add the TelemetryDeck analytics script to your WordPress site. Simply enter your App ID once, and the plugin will automatically load the script on every page. This plugin is lightweight and does not store personal data on your site.

Features:
* Easy integration with TelemetryDeck
* Top-level admin menu for App ID configuration
* Lightweight and fast

This is an independent integration and is not affiliated with TelemetryDeck.
sections.installation:
1. Create an account at https://telemetrydeck.com and copy your App ID.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  4. Paste your App ID in the plugin settings
sections.faq:
Do I need a TelemetryDeck account?

Yes, you need an App ID from TelemetryDeck.

Is this plugin affiliated with TelemetryDeck?

No, this is an independent integration.
